description: A poor connection: a congested mobile network or a server on another continent. 200 ms round trip with 40 ms of jitter, 5 % of the packets lost in each direction, a fifth of that in short bursts, and a few packets arriving twice.

allowances.reason: the round trip of 200 ms plus the jitter of 40 ms

notApplicable.reason: the profile loses 5 % of the packets, and owner snapshots travel unreliably, so some never arrive by design; snapshot_drops still judges whether the worker sent them all
